name: timeline-animation
blurb: List items fade in with blur-out animation as their timeline enters the viewport.
description: Each child animates in sequence when the parent container enters view, fading from blurred and translucent to sharp and opaque. Delay is based on animationNum. Uses Framer Motion with customizable variants.
use_when: Multi-step timelines, sequential lists, or process steps that reveal as the page scrolls.
avoid_when: When animation must replay on scroll in/out; once=true prevents re-animation after first viewport entry.
a11y: Child content renders normally; animation is decorative. No aria attributes or focus handling added.
